RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's gender composition alone is not evidence of discrimination, and raising it without concrete proof will harm your professional reputation. In healthcare administration, panel demographics often simply reflect available department heads and HR staff. 

Furthermore, laboratory leadership positions heavily prioritize operational management and people leadership over research degrees like a PhD. The successful candidate's formal management coursework and broad leadership experience make her appointment credible on merit. 

A two-week wait for institutional written feedback is also common. Rather than focusing on the panel's demographics, follow up politely regarding your feedback request, framing your inquiry around personal development and areas where you can strengthen your qualifications for future leadership roles.
